subtasks.title: Analyze current API endpoints and database schema for UI integration
required_actions: Review frontend TaskList.vue API calls
Examine backend server.js endpoints for project data
Check database schema for missing tables (phases, tasks)
Identify gaps between current JSON structure and database schema
acceptance_criteria: Document all API endpoints used by frontend
List database tables needed to replace JSON project structure
Create mapping between JSON fields and database columns

subtasks.title: Create database tables for phases and tasks if missing
required_actions: Create migration for phases table
Create migration for tasks table (if not exists)
Update subtasks table to include task_id and phase_id foreign keys
Run migrations to update database schema
acceptance_criteria: Phases table exists with columns: id, title, description, status, order_index
Tasks table exists with columns: id, phase_id, title, description, status, agent, subtask_ids array
Subtasks table has foreign key references to tasks and phases

subtasks.title: Implement database queries for project structure
required_actions: Create db.phases module with getAll, getById methods
Create db.tasks module with getByPhase, getAll methods
Create db.subtasks module with getByTask, getAllWithDetails methods
Implement joint query to fetch full project structure (phases -> tasks -> subtasks)
acceptance_criteria: db.phases.getAll() returns all phases with tasks
db.tasks.getByPhase(phaseId) returns tasks for a phase
db.subtasks.getByTask(taskId) returns subtasks for a task
Single query can fetch entire project hierarchy efficiently

subtasks.title: Update backend API endpoints to use database
required_actions: Update /api/project endpoint to fetch from database instead of JSON file
Create /api/phases endpoint for phase-specific data
Create /api/tasks endpoint for task management
Ensure /api/subtask/:id endpoint works with database (already exists)
Add error handling and validation
acceptance_criteria: /api/project returns same structure as archive/data/project.json but from database
All endpoints return appropriate HTTP status codes
Error messages are clear and actionable
API responses are consistent with frontend expectations

subtasks.title: Update frontend to use enhanced APIs and test integration
required_actions: Verify frontend TaskList.vue works with updated /api/project endpoint
Test subtask modal with /api/subtask/:id endpoint
Add loading states and error handling in UI
Test end-to-end data flow from database to UI
acceptance_criteria: UI displays project data from database without errors
Subtask modal shows full details from database
Activity log additions work via POST /api/subtask/:subtaskId/activity

message: Decomposed UI-database integration (Feature 2.4) into 5 subtasks focusing on database schema, API updates, and frontend integration. This will replace JSON-based project structure with PostgreSQL, enabling real-time updates and better data consistency.
